title: Glessner's street windows, sash by sash
items: The Glessner house's street and stable windows are now real double-hung sash: the upper sash sits outside the lower, each with its own frame and glass, over sills that slope to shed water.
The high window in the 18th Street gable is no longer a black slot. As the 1965 survey photograph shows it, it is a glazed round head over a stone transom, with a sash below.
